tools.name: bluecamroo_search_organizations
tools.description: Search organizations (accounts) with one rule: a property name, an operator and a value. Example: Name = Acme. Read only. BlueCamroo: POST api/account/search.

tools.name: bluecamroo_get_organization
tools.description: Get one organization (account) by id, with its addresses and roles. BlueCamroo: GET api/account/get/{id}. Read only.

tools.name: bluecamroo_get_person
tools.description: Get one person by id. A lead or a customer can also be a person. BlueCamroo: GET api/person/get/{id}. Read only.

tools.name: bluecamroo_get_opportunity
tools.description: Get one sales opportunity by id. BlueCamroo: GET api/opportunity/{id}. Read only.

tools.name: bluecamroo_get_project
tools.description: Get one project by id. BlueCamroo: GET api/project/get/{id}. Read only.

tools.name: bluecamroo_get_case
tools.description: Get one customer case (support case) by id. BlueCamroo: GET api/case/get/{id}. Read only.

tools.name: bluecamroo_get_task
tools.description: Get one task by id. BlueCamroo: GET api/task/get/{id}. Read only.

tools.name: bluecamroo_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one project invoice by id. BlueCamroo: GET api/Invoice/{id}. Read only.

tools.name: bluecamroo_get_sales_quote
tools.description: Get one sales quote by id. BlueCamroo: GET api/SaleQuote/{id}. Read only.

tools.name: bluecamroo_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact by id. BlueCamroo: GET api/contact/get/{id}. Read only.

tools.name: bluecamroo_get_time_entry
tools.description: Get one logged time entry by id (duration in seconds). BlueCamroo: GET api/time/get/{id}. Read only.

tools.name: bluecamroo_get_event
tools.description: Get one calendar event by id. BlueCamroo: GET api/event/get/{id}. Read only.

tools.name: bluecamroo_add_organization
tools.description: Create an organization (account). Id is set to 0 for you. Give Name and any other properties in fields. BlueCamroo: POST api/account/add.

tools.name: bluecamroo_update_organization
tools.description: Change properties of one organization. The current object is read first, then only the given fields change. BlueCamroo: GET api/account/get/{id}, then PUT api/account/update.

tools.name: bluecamroo_add_person
tools.description: Create a person. Give FirstName, LastName and any other properties in fields. Set IsLead or IsCustomer in fields when needed. BlueCamroo: POST api/person/add.

tools.name: bluecamroo_update_person
tools.description: Change properties of one person. The current object is read first, then only the given fields change. BlueCamroo: GET api/person/get/{id}, then PUT api/person/update.

tools.name: bluecamroo_add_task
tools.description: Create a task. Give Subject and, for a child task, ParentId and ParentObject (for example account, person, project or case) in fields. Priority is Low, Normal or High. BlueCamroo: POST api/task/add.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bluecamroo_search_organizations · Private data: bluecamroo_get_contact · Public sink: bluecamroo_search_organizations, bluecamroo_add_organization, bluecamroo_add_person, bluecamroo_add_task.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bluecamroo_search_organizations · Private data: bluecamroo_get_contact · Public sink: bluecamroo_search_organizations, bluecamroo_add_organization, bluecamroo_add_person, bluecamroo_add_task

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
